messages:
sara: Anyone else seeing a string of GHA infra helm failures in us-west? Started around 10:11 UTC, jobs killed mid-upgrade and helm complains about another operation in progress.
ben: I saw 2 failures in infra/cluster-config. Can you paste the error logs?
sara: paste from the runner log:```
Error: UPGRADE FAILED: another operation (install/upgrade) is in progress
helm.sh/helm/v3/pkg/action: failed to upgrade release \"infra-controllers\": failed to acquire lock: Pod eviction due to node termination
container termination: SIGTERM
```
kai: that typically means the job holding the release lock got terminated (preempt) and K8s is still cleaning up, so the next parallel job can't acquire the lock. We're seeing multiple preemption events on ephemeral-runner nodepool.
infra-bot: [autoscaler] nodepool/ephemeral-runner scaled DOWN 2 -> 0 (preemptible reclaim) at 2026-03-18T10:11:34Z
olivia: Did we change the runner pool to preemptible recently? I remember a tf tweak to save cost.
ben: checking state — yes, last week's change set flipped preemptible=true on that node pool. tf snippet from commit:```
resource "google_container_node_pool" "ephemeral-runner" {
  preemptible = true
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 0 max_node_count = 5 }
}
```
sara: that explains the correlation. Our infra helm jobs run a 4-way parallel matrix, so collisions are likely.
mike: short-term mitigations: reduce GHA parallelism for chart-upgrade jobs; add a repo-level semaphore (gh-action-lock) or a simple lockfile in GCS; add retry with exponential backoff around helm upgrade.
kai: suggestion for retry wrapper (simple bash):```
for i in 1 2 3; do
  helm upgrade --install infra-controllers ./charts/infra -n infra --wait --timeout 5m && break
  echo "helm upgrade failed, attempt $i"
  sleep $((i * 20))
done
```
olivia: moving the runners to non-preemptible will increase spend. Rough calc: adding a single n1-standard-8 in us-west ~= $0.40/hr => ~ $288/mo per node. If we need 2 nodes for capacity it doubles.
ben: I'll open a quick GHA patch to drop matrix parallelism from 4 -> 1 for infra chart jobs and add the retry loop. Kicking off a canary.
infra-bot: [gha-runner] canary run started (infra/helm-upgrade-canary) by ben (run 9742)
ben: canary passed :thumbsup: no helm lock errors on the single-run.
sara: follow ups: 1) guard our runner tf so nodepools with label infra=true cannot be created as preemptible, 2) add a repo-level resource lock for helm releases, 3) add metrics to track preemption->failed-job rate so we can justify spend.
mike: also consider dedicated non-preemptible pool for infra-critical pipelines only, and a cost/benefit doc for finance.
olivia: I'll sync with finance on the monthly impact if we provision 2 non-preempt nodes.
ben: opened PR #429 for workflow changes + retry wrapper. I'll include notes on reverting matrix if preemption rate drops.
sara: thanks all. I'll file a follow-up ticket for the TF guard and the lock action. :raised_hands:
